notes: Wire a 3-way multiple-choice classification task into an installed micro lm-eval harness: author the YAML config (choice order defines gold indices, so a wrong order or gold mapping collapses accuracy far below the graded 0.60-0.95 window), write a generic HTTP dataset driver, and produce the visible result over loopback HTTP. The verifier re-runs the driver on hidden corpora served over HTTP and recomputes every metric independently. Rubric marks: dependency chain (config -> driver -> served run), tool breadth (YAML + HTTP + harness import), reasoning depth (argmax/tie/skip semantics), adversarial inputs (skipped labels, empty text, decoy columns, case folding), hidden generalization and quantitative correctness (exact recomputed metrics), statefulness (loopback server lifecycle).
